page.layout: One column of running text. Printed notes in the left margin, in small Greek-style type, about twelve lines in groups of four. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: judices delatos ritè citabant, in compa-rentes & auditos & convictos, itemque in contumaces ac non comparentes sententias ferebant, eafque ipsi, si iis non pareretur, exequebantur, aut si id per se facere non poterant, executionem aliis, qui poterant, demandabant, horumque auxilium implorabant.Tantæ vero autoritatis hoc tribunal erat, ut raro sententiæ ab eo latæ irritæ transmitterentur, aut contra non parentes executione destituerentur, sæpè etiam gravium armorum vi, & concus-sione multorum populorum, judicata finem suum consequerentur. Coibat hoc concilium judicum quotannis bis, initio veris & autumni, temporibus scilicet statis: extra ordinem etiam, quoties res poscebat. Mittebant istuc populi, qui id jus habebant, assessores suos e medio sui à se designatos, binos aut ternos, pro cujusque potentiâ aut magnitudine, [illegible, ~6 letters]nonnulli etiam singulos [illegible, ~5 letters]tum[?] : quos Pylagoras quoque vul-[illegible, ~4 letters]sæculo florentis Græciæ nuncupa-tur, propterea, quod ad Pylas, quæ Delphis[?] erant juxta Apollinis fanum, [illegible, ~5 letters]veniebant, & tribunal suum exer-ant.[?] Qui autem populi jure Am-[illegible, ~4 letters][illegible, ~2 letters]yonico praediti alios in hoc judi-cio arcessebant, aut arcessentibus oc-

page.notes: Left margin: about twelve printed Greek-style marginal notes, too damaged to read; given as illegible. The word "tum" at the start of the fourth text line is partly covered by a margin mark; the "D" of "Delphis" is hidden by margin marks; "exer-ant" and "Am-yonico" are partly obscured, so their reading is uncertain. The catchword "curre" is printed at the lower right.
